Definition
[the upper half-space model]

Source: petersen:page-0153 ↗ def:pet-ch4-warped-product-general

On the half-space $x^n>0$, the metric $(1/x^n)^2\big((dx^1)^2+\dots +(dx^n)^2\big)$ becomes, with $r=\log (x^n)$, the warped product $g=dr^2+(e^{-r})^2\big((dx^1)^2+\dots +(dx^{n-1})^2\big)$.
